meta.title: SANTINEL — Everyone gets home safe
meta.description: SANTINEL helps the site manager see what matters in time: a forgotten helmet, an unclipped harness, dust over the limit. Fewer accidents, cleaner air for the neighbours.

hero.badge: Safer sites · Cleaner air for the neighbourhood
hero.subtitle: SANTINEL is a second pair of eyes for the site manager. It notices when someone forgot a helmet or harness, or when dust gets too high, and lets them know right away. A quick word fixes it before it becomes an accident.

problem.statement: On a construction site, most accidents don't come from bad intentions. They come from rushing, from fatigue, from "it's fine, just a minute". And the neighbours never chose to breathe the site's dust.
safetyItems: Workers without helmets or high-visibility vests
Work at height without a harness or safety line
People entering restricted zones under suspended loads
Theft of materials and tools, especially at night
airItems: Dust (PM10, PM2.5) above the legal limit in residential areas
Nobody measures it. Nobody is alerted in time
Water cannons start too late, or never

problem.closing: The site manager can't be everywhere. But they can know in time.

safety.title: A colleague who sees the whole site, every minute.
safety.intro: SANTINEL uses the cameras you already have. When it spots a dangerous situation, it sends the site manager a photo and the exact spot, so they can step in in time, with a word rather than a fine.

steps.title: Forgot the helmet
steps.desc: It happens: a break, a quick climb up the scaffold. The site manager knows right away and can remind them before anything falls.
steps.label: NO HELMET

steps.title: Harness not clipped
steps.desc: Falling from height is the most serious risk on site. SANTINEL notices anyone on scaffolding or at an edge who isn't secured.
steps.label: NO HARNESS · 6.2 m

steps.title: No vest near machinery
steps.desc: An excavator driver needs to see everyone around. A missing vest is flagged before it matters.
steps.label: NO VEST

steps.title: Too close to danger
steps.desc: Under the crane, near a trench, by the electrical panel. You choose the zones, and SANTINEL lets you know when someone steps in.
steps.label: RESTRICTED ZONE

steps.title: Materials leaving at night
steps.desc: When the site is closed, SANTINEL keeps watch. If someone walks out of the gate with materials, you get a clip right away.
steps.label: PERSON · MATERIALS

air.title: Clean air for the people who live next to the site.
air.intro: Small sensors on the site fence measure dust and noise. When levels rise, the site manager knows right away and knows exactly what to do.

steps.title: Always know the air quality
steps.desc: Three sensors on the fence, a reading every minute. The history is always there, including for the authorities.

steps.title: Know before the neighbours do
steps.desc: Demolition pushes dust over the legal limit, and the site manager is alerted on the spot, not after a complaint.

steps.title: Know what to do
steps.desc: Start the water cannons in the indicated zone. Within minutes, the air is back to normal.

air.alert: Too much dust: start the water cannons (N-E zone)

footer.tagline: The eye that watches over the site.

people.title: Made for the people on site, not to watch over them.

items.text: Gets home safe to their family. SANTINEL doesn't know who they are and doesn't tell on anyone: it only sees a missing helmet.
No more running from one end of the site to the other. They learn what matters in time, on their phone, and can focus on the work.
Breathe cleaner air and sleep easier. The site next door stops being a source of stress.
Fewer accidents, fines and work stoppages. And the name of a builder who looks after people.
